verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents token streaming or a real-time event stream of tool calls and steps for a UI. The nearest items are adjacent: step callbacks (documented for changing memory), manual step-by-step execution via agent.step(), and OpenTelemetry instrumentation for inspecting runs. These are developer building blocks or a different capability, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream tokens and intermediate agent events (tool calls, steps) to my UI in real time
